_meta.source: SRTR PSR National Center-Level Summary Data (January 2025 release)
_meta.method: Log-normal fit from center-level P25/P50/P75 wait time percentiles (Table B10)
_meta.notes: Empirical center-level data from SRTR. Blood type and clinical multipliers retained from literature-derived estimates (Table B10 does not stratify by blood type).

city_wait_time_factors._notes: Relative to national average (1.0). Computed as average center-median / national-median across available organs. Source: SRTR Table B10.
